ai_summary: Aarti Drugs Limited's subsidiary, Pinnacle Life Science, received three US FDA Form 483 observations following an inspection of its manufacturing facility. Crucially, none of the observations relate to data integrity, and the company asserts there will be no financial, operational, or other material impact, planning to work with the US FDA to resolve the findings. While Form 483s indicate potential compliance issues, the absence of data integrity concerns and the company's "no impact" statement mitigate immediate red flags.
